{{Spoiler}}

A '''golden carrot cupcake''' is the secret meal of the [[Golden Carrot|golden carrot]]. It heals {{Value|Golden Carrot Cupcake|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for {{Value|Golden Carrot Cupcake|duration|effect=Night Vision}}, the longest Night Vision in the pack.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/golden_carrot_cupcake.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A golden carrot, sugar, estus ash, cocoa beans and dough. The recipe is secret.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Golden Carrot Cupcake|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Golden Carrot Cupcake|heals}} and gives Night Vision for {{Value|Golden Carrot Cupcake|duration|effect=Night Vision|format=clock}}. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
